# TOWER ACK with a CTRL TLV tail (#470 §13.5, N1 part A): known-answer frames.
#
# Generated by firmware/fiber-northbridge/tests/tower_gateway/gen_ack_ctrl_kat.py
# (Python cryptography AESCCM, answers computed from the spec, not from the C code).
# Shared verbatim by the Northbridge (tests/tower_gateway) and the STICKER node; the
# link vectors are a separate file (p2p_tower_link_vectors.txt).
#
# Keys and addresses: tower_frame_kat.json - key 000102...0f, gw_addr 0x4e420001,
# node_addr 0x00000413. AES-128-CCM N=13 L=2 M=8, nonce src|counter|000000|0000,
# header (14 B) = AAD. Little-endian throughout.
#
# ACK plaintext: acked_counter(4) | rssi i8 | flags (b0 PENDING, b1 CTRL) [| TLV...]
# TLV = id(1) | len(1) | body, to the end of the plaintext (the 0x91 codec).
#   0x10 LinkCheckAns len 4: rssi i8 | snr i8 dB | margin i8 dB | gw_count = 1
#        snr = floor(snr_q / 4); margin = floor(snr_q / 4 - floor_sf),
#        floor_sf = -7.5 dB at SF7, 2.5 dB lower per SF step.
#   0x20 TimeAns len 9: unix u32 | frac (1/256 s, rounded down) | req_counter u32
#        = wall time at the end of the received uplink (RxDone, t_rx_ms on the NB
#        clock) through the TWR_TIME_SYNC anchor: anchor_unix_ms + (t_rx_ms -
#        anchor_now_ms); req_counter = that uplink's counter. No anchor: no TimeAns.
# Order in the tail: LinkCheckAns, then TimeAns. No answer: no tail, CTRL clear.
#
# Line kinds (whitespace-separated, key=value, '-' = empty / none):
#   <name> ack  up_ctr up_flags up_pt up_frame rssi_dbm snr_q sf t_rx_ms
#               anchor_now_ms anchor_unix_ms pending ack_ctr ack_pt ack_frame ack_len
#     The node's uplink (sealed by the node) and the gateway's ACK to it. The NB
#     builds ack_frame from the inputs; the node opens ack_frame and parses ack_pt.
#   <name> tail ack_ctr ack_pt tlvs ack_frame ack_len
#     Hand-built ACK plaintexts for the receiver's tail parser (tlvs = the ids it
#     must find, in order, unknown ones included); the NB only checks the sealing.
#
# LinkCheckAns only: SF7, SNR +5 dB -> margin 12.
